newsitem.title: USA: J.C. Penney comfortable with estimates.
newsitem.headline: J.C. Penney comfortable with estimates.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc Chief Financial Officer Donald McKay said Friday he was comfortable with the range of estimates by Wall Street analysts for the company's second quarter earnings of $0.34 to $0.42 a share.
"That's pretty much in the comfort zone," McKay said during an interview.
Wall Street analysts have estimated the company's earnings will be $0.37 a share, and the range of broker estimates was $0.34 to $0.42 a share, according to First Call.
Last year, Penney earned $93 million, or $0.37 a share, in the second quarter.
The retailer expects department store same-store sales, or sales of stores open a year, to increase by the low- to mid-single digits in percentage terms for the next few years, he said.
At the company's drugstore division, including the Eckerd drugstores it acquired earlier this year, same-store sales were expected to rise by 8 percent to 9 percent a year.
"We expect that kind of growth to go on for years," McKay said.
